overview_description.description: CyberGRX provides the most comprehensive third-party cyber risk management platform to cost-effectively identify, assess, mitigate and monitor an enterprise’s risk exposure across its entire partner ecosystem.  Through automation and advanced analytics, the CyberGRX solution enables enterprises to collaboratively mitigate threats presented from their increasing interdependency on vendors, partners and customers.  CyberGRX is based in Denver, CO.  For more information, visit www.cybergrx.com or follow @CyberGRX on Twitter.

about_short_description.short_description: CyberGRX is a provider a global cyber risk exchange for its third-party cyber risk management program.

product.name: ProcessUnity Platform
product.description: A scalable software solution designed to unify enterprise risk management processes and programs, offering features like no-code configuration, hands-free automation, and enterprise integration.

product.name: Vendor Risk Management Software
product.description: Automates the vendor onboarding process, inherent risk questionnaires, and due diligence, providing tools for efficient vendor evaluation, issue management, and performance reviews.

product.name: Vendor Sourcing (RFx)
product.description: Facilitates the vendor evaluation phase of the third-party risk management lifecycle by automating RFx processes, initial due diligence, and driving the awarded vendor through initial onboarding.

product.name: Vendor Performance Reviews
product.description: Enables organizations to configure and conduct vendor performance reviews, tracking SLAs, documenting KPIs, and monitoring vendor compliance and performance.

product.name: Vendor Due Diligence Software
product.description: Supports pre-contract due diligence and ongoing vendor monitoring, integrating cybersecurity ratings, financial ratings, and regulatory risk screening to enhance vendor evaluations.

product.name: Vendor Issue Management
product.description: Provides a workspace for tracking and managing issues identified during vendor risk assessments, facilitating collaboration between stakeholders for issue resolution.
